items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: Of course, you know about Lil' Jimmy the drummer. He died too.

ctx.x: At that time, I didn't keep anything. Of course, you know about Lil' Jimmy the drummer. He died too. Yeah. Lil' Jimmy. Yeah. You haven't met him, haven't you?
Yes. What about, did you ever hear old man Contrell, they call him, or Contrell? Contrell, played with P. Rowling and all.
